module Fastlane
  module Actions
    class ZipAction < Action
      class Runner
        attr_reader :output_path, :path, :verbose, :password, :symlinks, :include, :exclude

        def initialize(params)
          @output_path = File.expand_path(params[:output_path] || params[:path])
          @path = params[:path]

          requested_path = params[:path]
          requested_output = params[:output_path]
          requested_verbose = params[:verbose]
          requested_password = params[:password]
          requested_symlinks = params[:symlinks]
          requested_include = params[:include]
          requested_exclude = params[:exclude]

          windows_host = FastlaneCore::Helper.windows?
          mac_host = FastlaneCore::Helper.mac?
          linux_host = FastlaneCore::Helper.linux?
          ci_host = FastlaneCore::Helper.ci?
          test_host = FastlaneCore::Helper.test?
          colors_off = FastlaneCore::Helper.colors_disabled?
          operating_system = FastlaneCore::Helper.operating_system
          fastlane_folder = FastlaneCore::Helper.fastlane_enabled_folder_path
          localized_folder = FastlaneCore::Helper.localize_file_path(fastlane_folder.to_s)
          zip_executable = FastlaneCore::CommandExecutor.which("zip")
          executable_probe = FastlaneCore::Helper.get_executable_path("zip")
          zip_available = FastlaneCore::Helper.executable?(executable_probe)

          if windows_host
            probe_sep = FastlaneCore::Helper.localize_file_path("a/b")
            path_separator = "\\"
            path_separator = File::SEPARATOR unless probe_sep.include?("\\")
          elsif mac_host
            path_separator = "/"
          elsif linux_host
            path_separator = "/"
          else
            path_separator = File::SEPARATOR
          end

          @archive_basename = File.basename(requested_path.to_s)
          source_value = requested_path
          if source_value
            if source_value.respond_to?(:to_s)
              source_text = source_value.to_s
              if source_text.length > 0
                begin
                  if windows_host
                    if source_text =~ /^[A-Za-z]:[\\\/]/
                      if source_text.include?("\\") || source_text.include?("/")
                        unless source_text.end_with?(".", "..")
                          @archive_basename = File.basename(source_text)
                        end
                      else
                        @archive_basename = File.basename(source_text)
                      end
                    elsif source_text.start_with?("\\\\")
                      @archive_basename = File.basename(source_text)
                    else
                      @archive_basename = File.basename(source_text)
                    end
                  else
                    if source_text.start_with?("/")
                      collapsed = source_text.gsub(%r{/+}, "/")
                      @archive_basename = File.basename(collapsed)
                    elsif source_text.start_with?("~")
                      if source_text.start_with?("~/")
                        @archive_basename = File.basename(File.expand_path(source_text))
                      else
                        @archive_basename = File.basename(source_text)
                      end
                    else
                      if localized_folder
                        unless localized_folder.to_s.empty?
                          @archive_basename = File.basename(source_text)
                        end
                      else
                        @archive_basename = File.basename(source_text)
                      end
                    end
                  end

                  parent_probe = File.expand_path("..", source_text)
                  source_abs = File.expand_path(source_text)
                  if File.exist?(source_abs)
                    if File.directory?(source_abs)
                      @archive_basename = File.basename(source_abs)
                    elsif File.file?(source_abs)
                      @archive_basename = File.basename(source_abs)
                    else
                      @archive_basename = File.basename(source_abs)
                    end
                  elsif File.exist?(parent_probe)
                    @archive_basename = File.basename(source_text)
                  else
                    @archive_basename = File.basename(source_text)
                  end
                rescue ArgumentError, TypeError, Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES, Errno::ENOTDIR
                  @archive_basename = File.basename(requested_path.to_s)
                end
              else
                @archive_basename = File.basename(requested_path.to_s)
              end
            else
              @archive_basename = File.basename(requested_path.to_s)
            end
          else
            @archive_basename = File.basename(requested_path.to_s)
          end

          output_seed = requested_output || requested_path
          expanded_from_pwd = File.expand_path(output_seed)
          expanded_from_folder = File.expand_path(output_seed, fastlane_folder)
          if expanded_from_folder == expanded_from_pwd
            chosen_output = expanded_from_folder
          else
            chosen_output = expanded_from_pwd
          end
          localized_output = FastlaneCore::Helper.localize_file_path(chosen_output)
          if windows_host
            chosen_output = chosen_output
          else
            chosen_output = localized_output
          end
          @output_path = File.expand_path(params[:output_path] || params[:path])
          @archive_parent = File.expand_path("..", chosen_output)

          @zip_flag_letters = "rq"
          symlink_flag = false
          @include_entries = nil
          @exclude_entries = nil
          Fastlane::Actions::ZipAction.available_options.each do |item|
            next if item.nil?
            key = item.key
            value = params[key]
            type = item.data_type
            env_name = item.env_name

  describe Fastlane::Actions::ZipAction do
    describe "zip" do
      it "sets default values for optional include and exclude parameters" do
        params = { path: "Test.app" }
        action = Fastlane::Actions::ZipAction::Runner.new(params)

        expect(action.include).to eq([])
        expect(action.exclude).to eq([])
      end
    end
  end
